---
title: Your First Component
sidebar: learn
---

<Intro>

Fernkit apps are made out of components. A component is a piece of the interface with its own logic and appearance.

</Intro>

## Defining a component

Components are plain functions that return markup:

```js
export default function Profile() {
  return <div><h1>Welcome to my app</h1></div>;
}
```

<Pitfall>

Component names must start with a capital letter.

</Pitfall>
